## Notes

Release 2019-11-14, Matrix Games, Windows. Features: radar propagation, sensor degradation, terrain masking, sonar thermal layers, weather, ballistics; jamming, comms disruption, anti-radiation strikes; EMCON and weapon release authority doctrine; tactical AI; database of tens of thousands of platforms, sensors, weapons; thousands of active platforms in real time; Lua scripting; scenario editor; 600+ scenarios; Steam Workshop; real-time multiplayer PvP and co-op.
